target.geometry_state: uncrimped reference CAD; no measured crimp or heatshrink geometry
target.wire_basis: 14 mm legacy comparison only; no Ampere wire selection or electrical compatibility assertion
target.sleeve_basis: illustrative annular sleeve over uncrimped CAD, not actual heatshrink or crimp geometry

mechanism.mounting_basis: existing pad back plane only; screw pattern and strength unresolved

insert.edge_profile_basis: maximum absolute CAD side extent over the chosen Y band at each Z slice; 0.1 mm display gap, not a tolerance or acceptance limit
insert.guide_role: clearance guide, coupled to the terminal fingers; no independent wire clamp or force control

illustrative_surroundings.basis: comparison geometry only; not the actual busbar, fastener, tool or fixture

unresolved: Ampere terminal and wire part numbers and manufacturing dimensions
post-crimp outline, sleeve end and permitted gripping surfaces
vertical retention, roll and axial slip under cable bending load
fingertip material, friction, compliance, grip force and mounting screws
retention between hand release and fastening at the next station
continuous collision, arm motion, camera clearance and S-bend formation
